name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-fork
description: Fork-only plugins and composition overlays for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/build-harvest.mjs && pnpm run build:lib:host && pnpm --dir .. exec tsc -b fork/tsconfig.client.json
scripts.build:lib: node scripts/build-harvest.mjs && pnpm run build:lib:host && pnpm run build:lib:client
scripts.build:lib:host: pnpm --dir .. exec tsc -b fork/tsconfig.host.json && pnpm --dir .. exec tsdown --config fork/tsdown.config.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host
scripts.build:lib:client: pnpm --dir .. exec tsc -b fork/tsconfig.client.json && pnpm --dir .. exec tsdown --config fork/tsdown.config.ts --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run test
